title: Dodecahedral-Dual Route Graph
objective: Use the dual graph for adjacency without conflating vertices and faces.

repository_truth.head: de620bb
reused_engine: cwatlas.dodecahedron (dual, IcosaFaceId/DodecaVertexId, dual_vertex_of_face, require_dodeca_vertex, ConflationError) - NOT reimplemented

implementation.queries: neighbors, degree, deterministic BFS shortest_path with route certificates and a graph digest
implementation.bridge: root_vertex_for_face reuses dual_vertex_of_face (icosa face -> dual root vertex)

negative_results: An IcosaFaceId is not a DodecaVertexId: vertex-space queries refuse a face id or a bare int (require_dodeca_vertex / ConflationError).
A dodecahedral pentagon FACE is never the root: refuse_dodeca_face_as_root refuses it (the root is a face centre == dual vertex).
A vertex id, a path, and a hop count are combinatorial objects; a route length is not a physical distance and validates no source origin.

claims.statement: Adjacency and shortest-path routing run on the dodecahedral-dual vertex graph, wrapping the reused engine, with typed refusals against face/vertex conflation.

privacy_check: CLEAN - synthetic/public geometry only; no private reads, no personal names or filesystem literals
